nodes.description: Dermal collagen fibrils of carriers are larger and more variable in diameter and shape and less densely packed than normal. nodes.description: Histologically, foci of acute inflammation begin in the periosteum and spread into the adjacent soft tissues, producing the tender swelling over affected bones. Systemic markers of inflammation (ESR, C-reactive protein, immunoglobulins) rise. Because the neonatal immune system has blunted cytokine responses, the inflammation is thought to be a local, matrix-driven process.

meta.frequency: Found in most families tested: p.(Arg1014Cys) in 23 and p.(Arg918Cys) in 5 of 28 families sequenced in one series. A minority of clinically typical familial cases carry no COL1A1 or COL1A2 variant.

nodes.description: The initiating lesion is a heterozygous germline missense variant in COL1A1 that replaces an arginine with a cysteine in the triple-helical domain of the pro-alpha1(I) chain of type I collagen. The recurrent allele is c.3040C>T, p.(Arg1014Cys) (R836C in helical numbering); c.2752C>T, p.(Arg918Cys) is a second, less common allele. Neither is a glycine substitution of the kind that causes osteogenesis imperfecta. The structural-constituent function is marked ABNORMAL rather than DECREASED because the change is qualitative (aberrant disulfide-bonded chains, altered fibril diameter and packing and, per ClinGen, disrupted collagen-ligand interaction), not a loss of collagen quantity.

nodes.description: Hypothesised amplifier. nodes.description: Short-term anti-inflammatory, antipyretic and analgesic treatment for the swelling, fever and pain of an episode. Indomethacin, ibuprofen and naproxen have been used; case reports describe resolution of symptoms on indomethacin, and indomethacin allowed steroid withdrawal in relapsing twins. There are no controlled trials, and the disease is self-limited.
